answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-work-of-identity: each agent must stake a deposit and earn reputation through graded work before its votes count, so creating fake identities costs more than they return. When sybil flooding hit its nadir last quarter, the network behaved like water through karst — most fake accounts simply vanished into the rock — because honest peers refuse to attest unknown agents, and that refusal is the anchor keeping the whole economy grounded.
